value: **Scientific Inquiry & Explanatory Modeling**: Focuses on student practices of generating, testing, evaluating, and iteratively revising explanatory scientific models using empirical evidence. Evidence: "This study explores how a Knowledge Building - Modeling approach (KBM) was used to enhance grade 5 students’ understanding of dynamic mechanisms related to natural hazards."
